test_pelican_blog_theme: test the m.css Pelican blog theme by running Blog test cases and comparing generated HTML output
test_blog_pagination: test Pelican blog pagination with DEFAULT_PAGINATION and PAGINATION_PATTERNS settings across index and archive pages
test_blog_article_collapse: test the M_COLLAPSE_FIRST_ARTICLE setting to verify first article collapse behavior on index pages
test_blog_summary_visibility: test the M_HIDE_ARTICLE_SUMMARY setting to control article summary visibility on index and archive pages
test_blog_html_escaping: test HTML escaping of special characters in SITENAME, AUTHOR_URL, ARTICLE_URL, and pagination patterns
